_comment: Clawd Rive Theme Template — copy to {userData}/themes/your-theme-id/ or scaffold with: node scripts/create-theme.js my-rive --rive
name: My Rive Theme
author: Your Name
description: Open Rive (.riv) desk-pet theme. Default sample is the classic login Teddy (CC BY JcToon).

rive._comment: Bindings map Clawd's runtime signals (agent state / hover / pointer / click) onto THIS .riv's exact input names. The renderer is theme-agnostic — it just applies these. Sources: hover, stateIn, pointerX/pointerY, state (number map), constant, and on:{enterStates,click} for triggers. Set rive.fx=true for the optional glow/particle overlay.

hitBoxes._comment: viewBox units — cover the character so drag/click work. Do NOT reuse Clawd SVG defaults (~17×12).

eyeTracking._comment: Not supported with renderBackend rive — keep disabled.

states._comment: All agent states can share one .riv; the state machine carries the mood.
